_comment: What a healthy number looks like on the first-pass tuning, for the five signals in docs/design/vertical-slice.md. These are PREDICTIONS, written before the playtests, so that a disappointing result cannot be retrofitted into a satisfying one. They are the numbers most worth arguing with in this repo — argue by editing this file and saying why in the commit, not by rationalising a reading. Reasoning for each band, and what a breach implies: docs/design/measurement.md.

daylight_split.title: Daylight spent writing vs travelling
daylight_split.tells: Whether the central tension is live or one option dominates
daylight_split.metric: share of spent light that went to writing, %
daylight_split.healthy: A quarter to a half of the season's light goes to the Ledger. Below that, writing is a tax players pay grudgingly; above it, the road is decorative.
daylight_split.worrying: Under 25% is the 'players optimise writing away' failure condition. Over 45% means travel is too cheap to be a real alternative.

route_surveyed.title: A full route surveyed
route_surveyed.tells: Whether the automation goal is legible without being told
route_surveyed.metric: seasons until the route is documented whole
route_surveyed.healthy: Two to five seasons. Season one cannot finish it (three legs, forty days), so 2 is the floor and a run that reaches it has understood the goal.
route_surveyed.worrying: Above 5, the goal is either illegible or too expensive to pursue; a run that never documents it has failed the slice's whole question. Below 2 would mean the threshold is trivially cheap.

first_automated_return.title: Reaction at first automated return
first_automated_return.metric: not telemetry — a face, watched, at a moment the build can only point to
first_automated_return.healthy: An unprompted reaction — leaning in, a laugh, reading the caravan line twice, saying something out loud. Recorded by an observer against docs/design/playtest-script.md §3.
first_automated_return.worrying: Silence, or a scroll past. If the moment the whole slice exists to produce does not register, no number rescues it.

courier_use.title: Whether the Courier is used
courier_use.tells: Whether the cost is calibrated or prohibitive
courier_use.metric: share of seasons in which a courier was sent, %
courier_use.healthy: Sent in roughly one season in five. The Courier is meant to be an admission that a season is going badly, not a routine.
courier_use.worrying: Under 10% with entries being lost to deaths means the price is prohibitive and the seal economy is starving it. Over 40% means it is simply the correct move and has stopped being a decision.

season_two_delta.title: Whether season two differs from season one
season_two_delta.tells: Whether inheritance reads as progress or as a reset
season_two_delta.metric: legs of road the second scribe inherits from the first
season_two_delta.healthy: At least one leg carries. The second scribe should open on ground the first paid for, in a form they can see.
season_two_delta.worrying: Zero legs inherited is the 'inheritance reads as a reset' failure condition — season one bought the House nothing it can point at, and the generational premise is in trouble.
